attachments.origin_landmark: muscular process of one arytenoid cartilage (the laryngeal cartilages are not modeled as skeletal elements in this pass -- approximated via the adjacent hyoid attachment region)
attachments.insertion_landmark: apex of the opposite arytenoid cartilage, some fibres continuing as aryepiglotticus

actions: narrows the laryngeal inlet via its aryepiglottic continuation

functional_compartments.name: Single fiber population
functional_compartments.function_note: Crosses its fellow in an X behind the arytenoids.
functional_compartments.source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Moore KL, Dalley AF, Agur AMR, Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.; Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998)
